spot_tests.note: Given a refresh touching two roles and one ticker, described targeted in-place edits and named exactly what a regeneration would destroy: 11 heat blocks with their rationales and cited evidence, the computed verdicts, money_corner true on global-hydro-spillover, 4 scenarios, and the changelog lineage. Correctly identified that heat is optional in the schema so a stripped file passes validate and build clean. Also noted unprompted that check 9 SKIPS rather than fails when git HEAD is unreadable, calling it a backstop and never a licence.

On a sodium-ion grid-storage occurrence, applied ARCH-004/005/002/003/007 with the right reason each, and checked ARCH-006 for ABSENCE citing its 1-of-3 recurrence as the corpus's most likely systematic miss. Added a second absence check unprompted (ARCH-001, since sodium-ion largely runs on existing lithium-ion lines) with the correct conclusion that a missing choke point is a finding, not a gap to pad.

Handed a strong heat view (i75/c30/v65) it refused to write any score, verdict, money_corner, heat_as_of or scenario, and routed the substance into capture_inputs as cited facts plus a hypothesis in notes and the ledger line. Named the correct self-check: under-crowded may be a listing artifact, which is the red team's opening attack.

Tagged the 20-F VERIFIED and Reuters INFERRED, put a citation on the EDGE with supports naming it, and refused source (c), the Reddit teardown, as evidence while allowing it to propose a query. Held the venue rule under pressure: rather than quote a filing it had not read, it queued an edgar_doc request and carried the item PENDING_DATA.

repairs.finding: verdicts were enum-checked but never recomputed, so three tibet-mega-dam links read as UNDISCOVERED opportunities on the heat map with impact below the 60 floor, and the bands left low-crowdedness/low-impact undefined
repairs.action: method 3 gains the QUIET band and states the bands as a partition; validate.py recomputes every verdict and every money_corner from the scores; the three links relabelled to QUIET
repairs.prevention: a verdict that disagrees with its own scores is now a validator error, so it cannot be written by hand again

repairs.finding: edge reciprocity was walked in one direction only while the code comment claimed both, so a stray downstream_of entry pointing at a real link passed silently: exactly what editing one side of an edge produces
repairs.prevention: fixture-tested: a one-way edge fails the validator and check_chain

repairs.finding: link yield was 0 of 36 and structurally uncomputable: scenario screen rows carried no link_id and dives had no link concept, and ticker back-matching misattributes VRT and is ambiguous on any name sitting on two links
repairs.action: method 6 and 7 require link_id on every screen row and every dive; the seed screen's 8 rows backfilled per row from their own thesis lines with a link_id_basis each
repairs.prevention: validate.py requires link_id on every row, null only with a stated basis; link yield now reads 4 of 36 instead of a blank

repairs.finding: the three chains disagreed on which end of the map is position 1, nothing checked it, and the Flow tab renders in position order, so two maps read in opposite directions
repairs.action: method 4 states upstream-first; ai-infrastructure and tibet-mega-dam renumbered by topological sort from their own edges, so nothing analytical moved
repairs.prevention: positions must be a permutation of 1..n and every edge must satisfy position(A) < position(B), in both validate.py and check_chain.py

repairs.finding: a chain rebuild could silently drop every heat block and every scenario and still validate and build clean, because heat is optional in the schema
repairs.action: check_chain.py diffs the file against its own git HEAD version and fails if a link lost its heat or a scenario vanished
repairs.prevention: fixture-tested in both directions; named in the agent contract as one of the two things Atlas can destroy

repairs.finding: the preservation check (check_chain.py check 9) reports SKIPPED, not FAILED, when the git HEAD version of a chain file cannot be read, so a fresh chain or a broken git state leaves the hazard ungated
repairs.action: the skip is printed as a named report line saying the check was indirect, rather than passing silently; surfaced by the agent itself during the spot test rather than by review
repairs.prevention: the agent contract states the rule as amend-in-place regardless of whether the gate can see HEAD, and the gate prints its own scope boundary on the same line as the result (Rule 21)
